messages:
zoe.design: quick check on a compact preview row i've been prototyping for Run Explorer. goal: reduce vertical noise but keep essential structured info visible. figma: https://figma.redwood/s/slim-preview

jamie.devex: looks promising. question about copy: are we calling the control 'Preview' or 'Summary'?

zoe.design: mock uses 'Preview' visually, toggles to 'Full output'. tooltip: 'Show full function output'.

owen.product: 'Preview' might be confused with replay. 'Summary' could be clearer, or 'Compact view'. we should pick one and test.

nora.a11y: accessibility basics: toggle must be a real button (or role=button) with aria-expanded and aria-controls. visible text is required; icons alone won't do. ensure focus styles and color contrast pass.

kai.eng: impl notes: collapse when (tokens > 180 || lines > 8). streaming can append to the hidden node; reveal a slice for preview to avoid double buffering.

jamie.devex: can we include small key/value pills in the preview for status/error/latency? customers ask for that frequently.

zoe.design: yes — mock shows pills after the function name: status:ok, duration:32ms, trace:abc123. pills are subtle bg with 12px text.

nora.a11y: pills need accessible labels (aria-label="status: ok") and enough contrast. if pills are interactive (copy), they must be focusable buttons.

owen.product: microcopy for pills: short keys like 'status', 'time', 'id' with full tooltip on hover. also add an overflow menu (ellipsis) with actions: 'Copy summary', 'Copy JSON', 'Open inspector'.

kai.eng: menu will follow aria-haspopup and roving tabindex patterns. copying large JSON needs safeguards for streaming runs.

zoe.design: mobile behavior: stack pills under the name on narrow widths so they remain visible.

jamie.devex: also propose a header-level 'compact mode' toggle to hide pills globally for long histories.

nora.a11y: avoid global aria-live spam. use a single polite live region updated only on explicit expand/collapse: e.g., 'Expanded output for refine_query: status ok, 32ms'. keep the string short.

kai.eng: agreed; we'll build the live string from pill values and limit length to ~80 chars.

zoe.design: copy decision for now: 'Preview ▾' visually, aria-label='Show preview of tool output' when collapsed, and 'Show full output' when expanded. we'll A/B test 'Preview' vs 'Summary' in research.

owen.product: add 'Copy summary' as a top menu item — customers paste that into tickets often.

jamie.devex: implementation detail: persist collapsed state per-run in session so scrolling doesn't surprise users with expanded outputs.

nora.a11y: final a11y note: visible focus ring must contrast at least 3:1 and be early in the tab order before small icon controls. keyboard must toggle with Enter/Space and menu must be navigable by keyboard.

zoe.design: thanks — i'll update figma with pill placement inside preview row, aria attributes, live region example, mobile stacking, and menu actions. will post a PR for the component tomorrow for review.

kai.eng: i'll add unit tests for the collapse heuristic and an e2e for keyboard interactions.

owen.product: i'll run this with a couple of pilot customers and report back.

jamie.devex: LGTM, small follow-up: consider an optional tiny badge hiding mode in header for ultra-compact sessions.

zoe.design: good idea, adding to follow-up backlog. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
